cases.query: What are the signs of a stoma infection?
cases.passage: Redness, swelling, warmth or pus around the stoma can be signs of infection. Contact your stoma nurse.

cases.query: What are the signs of a stoma infection?
cases.passage: Eat small, frequent meals and drink plenty of fluids after bowel surgery.

cases.query: Can I shower with a colostomy bag?
cases.passage: Yes. You can shower with or without your pouch; water will not get into the stoma.
A temperature above 38°C in the first weeks after surgery needs a call to your surgical team.
